recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的細胞團中可見一顆巨核細胞，細胞質內散布多個分離的圓形核（類似散落的棋子），周圍有顆粒球系前驅細胞與脂肪空泡，為典型的多核發育不良巨核細胞。
features: Megakaryocyte with numerous discrete, separated round nuclei within shared basophilic cytoplasm
Nuclei of similar size with moderately condensed chromatin
Surrounding granulocytic precursors and neutrophils, some with hypogranular cytoplasm
Occasional erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei
Multiple fat vacuoles within a cellular particle
describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle with fat vacuoles containing a megakaryocyte with numerous discrete, separated round nuclei in a shared basophilic cytoplasm. The surrounding marrow includes granulocytic precursors, neutrophils and erythroid precursors, some granulocytes appearing hypogranular. Megakaryocytes with multiple separated nuclei are a defining dysplastic feature when present in at least 10% of megakaryocytes. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia in a myeloid neoplasm associated with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain many uniform nuclei with prominent nucleoli and granular pink-purple cytoplasm, and are usually found near bone spicules.
Reactive megakaryocytes have a single polylobated nucleus with connected lobes.
Megaloblastic marrow shows hypersegmented megakaryocyte nuclei with open chromatin plus megaloblastic erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes.
